scriptText:
Pip the fox finds a fallen star-shaped lantern beside the cedar.
Pip sees that its light dims when carried too quickly.
Moss the rabbit explains that gentle steps keep the light steady.
They walk together along the marked forest path.
They return the lantern to its stand beside the cedar.
The lantern glows and both friends celebrate helping their forest.
